sustained_title: Keep up a pace or an accuracy for as long as you can

status.num_lock_off_title: the number pad sends arrows while num lock is off
status.focus_click: click or press any key to focus

instructions.standard: Type the text shown. Space moves to the next word and Backspace corrects. Tab then Enter restarts. Escape opens the command line.
instructions.sustained: Keep your pace at or above the target. Three seconds below it ends the test. Space moves to the next word and Backspace corrects. Tab then Enter restarts. Escape opens the command line.
instructions.accuracy: Keep your accuracy at or above the target while typing at a steady pace. Five seconds below it ends the test. Space moves to the next word and Backspace corrects. Tab then Enter restarts. Escape opens the command line.
